summary: The Model AI Governance Framework (MAIGF) provides detailed guidance on implementing responsible AI practices. Published by the Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC) and IMDA, it adopts a risk-proportionate approach emphasizing human-centric AI deployment and organizational accountability.

risk_tiers.description: AI systems where decisions have significant impact on individuals and are fully autonomous with no human involvement in decision-making.
criteria: Autonomous decision-making with significant individual impact
AI determines outcomes in healthcare diagnosis or treatment
AI-driven decisions in criminal justice or law enforcement

risk_tiers.description: AI systems with significant impact on individuals but with human oversight in the decision-making process.
criteria: AI assists in medical diagnosis with physician review
AI recommends financial products with advisor oversight
Automated screening with human final decision

risk_tiers.description: AI systems operating autonomously but with limited impact on individuals' rights or wellbeing.
criteria: Autonomous operation with limited individual impact
Automated customer service for non-critical queries

risk_tiers.description: AI systems with limited autonomy and limited impact, posing minimal governance concerns.
criteria: AI-assisted spell checking or grammar tools

key_obligations.obligation: Establish internal governance structures and measures including clear roles, risk assessment processes, and decision-making frameworks for AI deployment
Determine and implement appropriate level of human involvement in AI-augmented decision-making based on risk severity and probability of harm
Implement operations management practices including data management, model monitoring, and performance tracking throughout the AI system lifecycle
Provide clear communication to stakeholders about AI-driven decisions, including explanations of how decisions are reached and avenues for recourse
Implement measures to minimize bias and ensure fairness in AI decision-making, including regular testing and monitoring for discriminatory outcomes

enforcement_timeline: Voluntary framework; organizations encouraged to adopt progressively. Implementation Companion Guide (A.I. Verify) available for self-assessment since 2022.
recent_changes: AI Verify Foundation launched as an open-source testing framework and governance toolkit
Generative AI governance guidance published addressing foundation model risks
Updated companion guide with practical implementation examples
